title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount robe hook built from brass and designed to coordinate with the Malibu collection.

Highlights:
- Robe hook / towel hook for hanging robes, towels, or clothing
- Wall mount hardware included; color-coordinated mounting hardware
- Contemporary design for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Assembled in the USA
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Category: Robe Hooks
- Collection: Malibu
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 2 in (L) x 2 in (H) x 2.64 in (W)
- Projection: 2.64 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 0.5 lb
- Screw size: 6
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
